{{Quote|The only entrance is the bridge to the main gate, and it's well guarded. Castle Renvall is a natural stronghold, easy to defend and difficult to assault. We must plan our attack carefully.|[[Seth]]}}

'''Waterside Renvall''' (Japanese: {{hl|水城レンバール|Mizuki renbāru}} ''Moat-Castle Renvall'') is the seventh chapter of {{FE8}}. [[Eirika]] leads an assualt on [[Renvall]], fighting [[Grado]] head-on in hopes of rescuing her brother [[Ephraim]], who is rumored to be held prisoner there.

==Plot==
{{main|Waterside Renvall/Script}}
When [[Eirika]] and her company reach the exterior of [[Renvall]], [[Seth]] explains the advantages the soldiers protecting Renvall have, and Eirika's recruited companions all state their renewed determination.

After Eirika's seizing of the castle's gate, she and Seth journey into the fortress and find [[Orson]] by himself. Eirika expresses her concern for Orson's well-being, but the absence of [[Ephraim]] makes Seth suspicious of Orson. Eirika and Seth allow Orson to guide them to the prisoner cells to free Ephraim.

==Strategy==
{{strategy}}
This chapter is very straightforward, just move towards the castle and kill everything in your way. If you really want the [[Energy Ring]], bring [[Colm]] along so that he can steal it. The [[ballista]] may be irritating, especially if you are using [[Vanessa]], but you can easily send another unit north to take care of it.

The [[Murray|boss]] is nothing special. First attack from afar with [[Magic (element)|magic]] or [[bow]]s then finish him off with heavy hitters like [[Eirika]]'s [[rapier]]. Kill the boss, then seize the gate.

==Trivia==
* This chapter featured fog of war in [[Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones prototype|''The Sacred Stones''{{'}}s prototype]].
